expires_today.title: Framing, Carpentry, and Fine Woodworking by Taunton Press
expires_today.long_description: Interested in trying out woodworking but never knew where to start? A veteran carpenter looking to pick up some new skills? This is the bundle for you, chock-full of resources and manuals that will help you achieve your loftiest woodworking dreams! Learn the ins and outs of home renovation! Get a crash course in framing a house! Fill your dream home with cabinetry, tables, and chairs made by you! There’s a certain satisfaction in making the things you use every day, and this bundle will teach you exactly how to bring your woodworking projects to life. Grab these instructional ebooks now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Humble Handhelds
expires_today.description: Worlds of adventure in the palm of your hand
expires_today.long_description:
What’s better than immersing yourself in a great story with compelling characters and a unique style? Being able to take it with you wherever you go! Every action and adventure game in this bundle has been hand-picked for your handheld console, as portable as they are fun! Traverse the barren plains and one-horse towns of Blood West, a Wild West horror game starring an undead gunslinger! Play as every member of a powerful family and fight the looming Corruption through dungeons and fantasy lands in Children of Morta: Complete Edition! Gather allies to win turn-based battles to save the land of Tahnra in Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga! There are even more adventures to be had in this bundle of games, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the Breast Cancer Research Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 5th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Liminal Spaces
expires_today.long_description:
There are few things scarier than being trapped in a place that shouldn’t exist—and that’s exactly why we love playing liminal horror games! With the Backrooms movie taking over movie theaters this summer, now’s the time to see how well you’d survive in these hostile environments full of monsters and other oddities. Inspired by the Backrooms urban legend, in The Cabin Factory your job is to explore a series of cabins looking for hauntings—and get out fast if you find any! For a more traditional approach, The Backrooms: Survival turns liminal horror into a roguelike survival game you can play solo or with friends! Enter these cursed, otherworldly places if you dare at the price of your choice, and support Spaceship Earth UK with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Redeem all others before August 5th, 2027

expires_today.title: Complete Character Creation for Games
expires_today.description: Bring characters to life in Blender
expires_today.long_description:
Dying to design your own epic game but have no idea where to begin? Been poking around in Blender but haven’t figured out all the tips and tricks?
